title: Normalized page row consumed by retrieval (Track B input)
description: One row of data/processed/<processed_root>/<document_id>/pages.jsonl as written by scripts/normalize_thai.py. Lists only the fields retrieval depends on; the producer may add others.

pdf_page.description: One-based PDF page index, blank pages included.

text.description: Retrieval text after normalization (or OCR text when text_source is ocr).

status.description: figure_review and review_hold come from normalize_thai.py v2; like degraded/garbled they are not indexed until a person reviews the page.

human_review.description: null until a person reviews the page; required before degraded/ocr_unreviewed pages are indexed.

population.description: Who the page is written for (Track B page tags, normalized-v8 onwards); absent means general.

index_exclusion.description: Present when a person or a rule removed the page from search (personal data, low content, awaiting OCR...); the retriever must skip the page.

category.description: Booklet category of the page (side tab), when the document has one.
